text:
alex.g: Heads up — spotted a small but weird pattern: some tenant invoice preview shows double-counted streaming tokens when requests route through the edge-shadow path. Not affecting ledger yet, but console preview spikes.
maya_ops: ack — can you paste an example tenant id / trace id?
alex.g: tenant=t-42 trace=trc_6b9f, preview at 2026-03-21T14:12:03Z shows ~2.3M tokens vs usual 1.1M. Ledger pipeline (post-aggregation) remains ~1.1M. Snapshot: 
```
preview: {tenant: "t-42", window: "2026-03-01..2026-03-21", tokens_preview: 2300451}
ledger: {tenant: "t-42", tokens_invoiced: 1102120}
```
raj_platform: hmm. edge-shadow path duplicates a small subset of events for visibility. I thought we dedup by request_id + route_fingerprint before preview aggregation. Maybe shadow adds a different metadata header so dedupe key misses.
sara_billing: we saw a few similar tickets from SRE last month re: `edge-shadow` tag. Billing preview joins on `fingerprint || tenant || hour`. If shadow alters fingerprint (eg adds `edge:shadow`) it could create a distinct bucket.
alex.g: exactly — raw events show `fingerprint=fp_123` for live, `fingerprint=fp_123|shadow` for shadow. We probably want to normalize before preview grouping.
maya_ops: quick question — are these preview-only problems (UX) or do they risk slipping into invoice path?
sara_billing: currently safe: downstream ingest dedupe (in the final path) strips tag and normalizes, so real invoices are fine. But preview uses nearline index that runs a lighter normalization to be fast. That is where the mismatch is.
raj_platform: suggestion: update nearline normalization pipeline to run the same fingerprint_normalizer v2 we use in final-ingest. It's heavier but we can gate it behind a config flag `preview_normalize=true` and roll it out slowly.
alex.g: +1 for gated flag. Also console should indicate "preview includes shadowed events" when enabled so support doesn't panic. Maybe a subtle banner in invoice preview.
maya_ops: what about backfilling previews already shown to customers? Any approach to mark them as transient so we don't mislead?
sara_billing: there are two UX fixes: 1) post a sticky note on the preview card: "estimates may include shadow routes — final invoice unaffected"; 2) add an alert in console when preview_delta > X% vs ledger_histogram. But that could be noisy.
raj_platform: operationally we should also add a sampling flag on shadowed events to avoid overwhelming nearline during canaries. Right now we forward 100% of shadowed traffic to preview index. If we sample 5% instead, users' preview accuracy for canary routes will drop but reduce noise.
alex.g: Does anyone have a quick patch outline? I can PR for the banner and alert thresholds. Raj/Maya — can you own pipeline flags and sampling?
maya_ops: I'll open a rollout ticket for `preview_normalize` + sample config and add a gradual ramp (5% -> 20% -> 100%). Timeline: start canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC, monitor previews for top 100 tenants.
sara_billing: I'll add a console CTA and a support FAQ blurb. Also will update the invoice preview API to include a `preview_meta` field that lists `sources_included: ["edge-live","edge-shadow-sampled"]` so customers can see when shadow was counted.
raj_platform: FYI we need to ensure the `preview_meta` addition doesn't break mobile clients; we should add it as an optional field. Also update telemetry for `preview_normalizer_version` so we can A/B compare.
alex.g: Here's a small log snippet if helpful: 
```
2026-03-21T14:12:02Z | ingest-nearline | tenant=t-42 fp=fp_123|shadow preview_insert
2026-03-21T14:12:03Z | ingest-nearline | tenant=t-42 fp=fp_123 live_insert
```
sara_billing: Thanks. One operational note: support will want a quick way to show "non-shadowed preview" — add a query param `?include_shadow=false` to the preview API so UI can toggle.
maya_ops: good call. We'll implement sampling config + `include_shadow` flag. Raj/eng-runtime please add telemetry count `preview_shadow_hits` and `preview_shadow_tokens` to SLO dashboards.
raj_platform: will do. Also adding an automated pager if `preview_shadow_tokens` exceeds 25% of preview_tokens for top-20 tenants.
alex.g: Any objections to the rollout plan?
sara_billing: none from billing. Also request that the console show both numbers side-by-side (preview_with_shadow vs preview_without_shadow) in the tenant dashboard for 7d.
raj_platform: minor engineering ask: nearline index normalization will add ~60ms per ingest; with sampling we should be fine, but we need to watch the backpressure metrics. I'll add headroom alert.
maya_ops: ok locking owners: alex.g -> console banner + API param PR, sara_billing -> support copy + preview_meta, raj_platform -> nearline normalization rollout + telemetry, maya_ops -> sampling & rollout orchestration. We'll sync in #eng-platform-ops in 30m.
billing-bot: [automated] Created ticket BP-4391: "preview_normalize rollout + shadow sampling" assigned to raj_platform, maya_ops. Link: https://issues.redwood.ai/BP-4391 :spiral_calendar:
alex.g: thanks team. Hoping this will reduce surprised customers and make preview numbers trustworthy again. :thumbsup:
